$comment: Ordered day-by-day schedule. Dates are NOT stored — they are derived by
walking this list from settings.trip.startDate, so changing the start date
or toggling a rest day reflows everything automatically.
rest  -> no walking; still occupies a calendar day and a night
travel-> getting to or from the trailhead
stayAt is the anchor key where the group sleeps that night, and is what
data/stays.json keys its lodging options against.

days.label: Arrive Chamonix
days.note: Fly in, settle, gear check. Carte d'Hôte from the hotel makes valley buses free.
We sleep in Chamonix the night before, so the day opens with Chamonix Bus line 1 down to Les Houches — free with the Carte d'Hôte.
Longest climb of the first half. Col de la Croix du Bonhomme at 2,433 m.
Navette up to Ville des Glaciers. Buy tickets the evening before — they sell out.

days.label: Rest day — Courmayeur
days.note: Four-star resort and spa. Laundry, resupply, and an easy afternoon.

No La Fouly night, so this is the old day 4 and day 5 in one. The classic line is 48 km over the Grand Col Ferret; the shortcut rides the Val Ferret bus to Arnouvaz, walks the col to La Fouly, then takes the bus on through Orsières.
Bovine route by default. Fenêtre d'Arpette is the high alternative — see the variant toggle.
Over Col de Balme to Le Tour, then Chamonix Bus line 1 back to town.

days.label: Chamonix
days.note: Second of the two nights back in the valley. Nothing planned beyond a long lunch.
